Create one original Summonlab candidate summon portrait as a cinematic semi-realistic painted drawing. Use visible brush planes and controlled illustrative detail: not a photograph, not photoreal skin, not plastic 3D, and not cel anime. Portrait canvas 1024 x 1536. Exactly one weaponless adult, full body, three-quarter standing pose, with the entire head, both hands, both feet, hair, clothing, and all accessories fully inside a generous safe margin. Warm pale parchment studio wash, restrained warm color response, soft grounding shadow, no environmental story.

New identity Isar Vesha: 38-year-old woman, 184 cm (tall), sturdy stocky construction with a broad frame and compact proportions, skin value band-3-light-medium. Face: long narrow face; asymmetric brows and broad cheek planes; crooked healed nose, balanced mouth; faint freckles. Calm closed-mouth neutral expression with no smile, grin, or theatrical acting.

Hair: red-copper-auburn, braids-twists-locs, deliberate accent: none. Wardrobe: tailored-longcoat, specifically a cloth longcoat with a readable waist, split hem, plain underlayer, and fitted shoes; a divided hem and broad folded collar; bounded palette oxblood-navy. Visible personal details: no accessory and no tattoo. Make the hair construction the primary recognition silhouette. Maintenance cue: deliberately tousled but clean. Color treatment: uses high-contrast lining visible only in motion. Pose cue: one thumb hooks lightly beneath the waist wrap while the other hand rests open. Include a polished seed case only as a quiet personal object, never as a weapon.

This is ordinary but intentionally designed 1-star mortal clothing. No weapon, armor, crown, magic, aura, or glow.
